svg.title: XGBoost roadmap
svg.desc: Eight stages from loading data to reading the fitted model, with the variable passed between each stage, the target y skipping encoding, the test rows held back until scoring, validation rows held back from the training rows so the model can check itself, optional simpler models for comparison, and a panel showing how .fit() adds one small tree at a time, each fitted to the errors left by the trees before it.
svg.text: XGBoost roadmap: how the code blocks connect
Each box is a stage in the code. The label on each arrow is the variable handed to the next stage.
